883-1339-1832-2034.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
883-1339-1832-2034.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

4247-5254-6774.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
4247-5254-6774.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4054-4549--52.description:
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Grimgrin, adding an additional mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3899-6014-6659.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another modified creature.
When the creature dies, Guardian of the Forgotten triggers, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters the battlefield, Gylwain triggers, creating a Role token attached to the manifested creature.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

147-3899-7446.easyPrerequisites: There's a nonland permanent card in your graveyard.
147-3899-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

341-1170-2921-5131--202.easyPrerequisites:
Umori has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
341-1170-2921-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Umori.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7934.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Federation Field Medic.
When Federation Field Medic dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Federation Field Medic enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2178-5686-7690-7797--165.description:
Activate Agent Phil Coulson by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Hero you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token with defender.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Wall.
When the Wall dies, Agent Phil Coulson triggers, untapping Agent Phil Coulson.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1167-5382-7692.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Illustrious Wanderglyph triggers, creating an artifact token.
Activate Shuri by paying {1} and tapping it, causing the artifact token to become a copy of Mindslaver that isn't legendary.
Activate the artifact token by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

1987-2128-7487.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature, or land that can produce at least {U} the turn it enters the battlefield.
1987-2128-7487.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U} due to Hinata, blinking Zealous Lorecaster and the permanent tapped for mana in step 1.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

2388-3263-6568-6587.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
2388-3263-6568-6587.description:
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

5742-6666-6786.easyPrerequisites: You have an Island, Pirate or Vehicle card in hand or on top of your library.
5742-6666-6786.description:
Activate Mary Read and Anne Bonny by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and then discard an Island, Pirate or Vehicle card.
The discarded card is put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Library of Leng.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Rook Turret triggers, causing you to draw a card and then discard an Island, Pirate or Vehicle card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

1257-3259-3861--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1257-3259-3861--85--106.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6730-6972.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2438-6730-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the additional creature.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Sin from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As Sin enters, remove the -1/-1 counter from the creature sacrificed in step 1, causing Sin to enter with a +1/+1 counter on it instead.
Resolve the second Sin trigger, putting the counters it had on it when it was sacrificed onto a creature you control and failing to shuffle it into your library as it's no longer in your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 4.
Repeat.

1409-3128-4365.description:
Activate Skullport Merchant by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Skullport Merchant enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Skullport Merchant.
Resolve the Skullport Merchant trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7157.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Arcbound Lancer.
When Arcbound Lancer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Lancer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Lancer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2558-5330-7082.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sokka and Suki trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Ally.
Repeat from step 2.

198-585-3767-3918.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
198-585-3767-3918.notes: If Trazyn starts the combo with any number of charge counters on it, the needed mana is {1} instead.

2511-4484-4871-6518.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
2511-4484-4871-6518.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Zombie Druid.
When the Zombie Druid dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

5657-5860-6489.manaNeeded: {4}{C}{C}{C}{G/U}{G/U} plus enough mana to cast the additional Eldrazi spell
5657-5860-6489.notablePrerequisites: You have another Eldrazi creature card in hand.
5657-5860-6489.description:
Cast any other Eldrazi except Drowner of Truth by paying its mana cost, triggering Ulalek.
Holding priority, cast Drowner of Truth by paying {4}{C}{G/U}{G/U}.
Drowner of Truth and Ulalek trigger.
Resolve the Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Drowner of Truth's trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1799-2579-2701-4050-5913.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Pinnacle Monk, adding one mana of any color.
When Pinnacle Monk dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Pinnacle Monk from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Pinnacle Monk from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Grenzo's ability any number of times.

3398-3973-4214.notablePrerequisites:
Rith does not have summoning sickness.
There is at least ten permanents of any one color on the battlefield.
An opponent cannot block Rith or Hellkite Charger.
3398-3973-4214.description:
Declare Rith and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Rith.
Rith triggers, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least ten 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare Rith and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, holding priority, activate Utopia Mycon's second ability seven times by sacrificing seven Saprolings, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Rith.
Rith triggers, holding priority, activate Utopia Mycon's second ability three times by sacrificing three Saprolings, adding {2}{G}.
Resolve the Rith trigger, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least ten 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Repeat from step 5.
If there are at least eleven permanents of any color on the battlefield, this combo nets infinite Saproling tokens and colored mana.

1641-2034-2054-4192.notablePrerequisites: "Spirit" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
1641-2034-2054-4192.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Urn of Godfire's first ability by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

2084-3893.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Shapeshifter.
2084-3893.description:
Cast Absorb Identity by paying {1}{U}, returning Mirror-Mad Phantasm to your hand from the battlefield, and causing each Shapeshifter you control to become a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm until end of turn.
Activate a Shapeshifter by paying {1}{U}, shuffling it into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

643-862-1789-2232.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, Lathliss and Cloudstone Curio triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

490-2097-2440-2972.notablePrerequisites:
You control a modified creature that can attack this turn.
You control at least two additional Dragons and/or Spirits.
490-2097-2440-2972.description:
Declare any modified creature you control as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Goro-Goro's second ability by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a 5/5 Dragon Spirit creature token with flying.
When the Dragon Spirit enters the battlefield, it triggers Mana Echoes and Ganax.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
 Once you have infinite tokens, you may use Goro-Goro's first ability to give them haste.

575-3510-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
575-3510-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering Yedora, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 Saproling due to Life and Limb.
Repeat.

687-2034-4626.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
687-2034-4626.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature, adding {C}{C}.
Promise of Bunrei triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and create four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens that enter the battlefield with vigilance counters on them.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three vigilance counters from the Spirits, causing yourself to mill three cards and return Promise of Bunrei from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Spirits, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1309-1518-1987-5116.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1309-1518-1987-5116.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
